title: Pasilla Drosophila RNAi RNA-seq counts bundled with DESeq2
kind: study data; bundled processed count matrix and sample annotation
provenance: Observed RNA-seq study data, distributed here as gene-level count and sample-annotation assets copied from the Bioconductor pasilla data package according to the vignette. Original FASTQ/counting pipeline details were not inspected.

biological_context.experimental_units: Seven Drosophila melanogaster cell-culture samples: three treated and four untreated, per bundled annotation.
biological_context.assay: RNA-seq; annotation reports single-read or paired-end type, number of lanes, total reads and exon counts.
biological_context.design: RNAi knock-down of splicing factor pasilla; vignette gives condition-only and type-adjusted (~ type + condition) examples.

assets.processing_stage: bundled gene-level counts; upstream quantification/count-generation stage not established here
assets.relationship: Count matrix used with the accompanying annotation; no file was downloaded.
Seven rows identify sample condition and sequencing type; vignette strips fb prefix and reorders rows to count matrix columns.

access_and_terms.access: Public repository source files readable through GitHub; no authentication required in inspected view.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown for biological data. DESCRIPTION declares package code License LGPL (>= 3); that does not prove the dataset assets have the same redistribution terms.

inspection: Inspected pinned repository tree metadata, reported file sizes, full sample annotation CSV, and the vignette sections loading/reordering the files and describing the study; counts matrix was not downloaded or previewed.
limitations: Underlying study/sample accession and original processing steps remain unknown from inspected sources.
No checksum or content preview of compressed counts was obtained.
Redistribution eligibility and terms of original pasilla package data remain unverified.

title: tximportData Salmon quantification demonstration inputs
kind: demonstration fixture and candidate input data
provenance: Unknown observed/adapted/simulated status and study identity; DESeq2 vignette references installed extdata from tximportData solely as a demonstration.

biological_context.assay: RNA-seq transcript quantification is implied by Salmon quant.sf files; biological/sample design details not inspected.
biological_context.design: Vignette constructs two condition labels for demonstration, but says typical users already have condition metadata.
metadata: run identifiers and an artificial condition column in example; other fields in samples.txt were not inspected

assets.format: Package extdata: samples.txt, salmon/<run>/quant.sf.gz, tx2gene.gencode.v27.csv (formats inferred from vignette paths)
assets.processing_stage: quantified transcript abundance files and transcript-to-gene mapping; exact files/content were not read
assets.relationship: Together form the demonstrated tximport inputs; data identity and consistency not verified.

access_and_terms.access: Vignette indicates public Bioconductor package distribution; package files were not retrieved.

inspection: Inspected the vignette's tximport section and exact example package/file path names only; no package metadata or biological files fetched.
limitations: Source study, organism, sample count, accessions, size, format details, and reuse terms need inspection in tximportData package metadata/source.
Possible relationship to other datasets is unknown; kept as a separate record from pasilla.

title: Airway package RangedSummarizedExperiment example
kind: candidate study dataset; package demonstration input
provenance: Unknown from the inspected DESeq2 vignette section; the airway package supplies the example object.

biological_context.assay: RNA-seq counts implied by DESeq2 input; not directly described in inspected lines.

assets.format: RangedSummarizedExperiment object in an R package
assets.processing_stage: preconstructed count/metadata object; assay provenance not inspected
assets.relationship: Single example object loaded from airway package; contents not fetched.

access_and_terms.access: Public package link in vignette; package contents not retrieved.

limitations: Study DOI/accession, organism, sample count, assay details, asset size and redistribution terms remain unknown.
